newsitem.title: USA: Inland, Altos explore Venezuela steel bid.
newsitem.headline: Inland, Altos explore Venezuela steel bid.

text.p: Inland Steel Industries Inc said it is exploring the possibility of joining Altos Hornos de Mexico SA in submitting a bid to acquire steelmaker Siderurgica del Orinoco CA of Venezuela.
Inland and Altos are joint-venture partners in Ryerson de Mexico, a Mexican steel distributor.

The Venezuelan company, also known as Sidor, is wholly owned by that nation's government, which has said it intends to privatize Sidor in the near future. The government has said it is preparing a bidding process for Sidor, Inland said.
Altos and 10 other companies have been qualified by the Venezuelan government as potential bidders, Inland said.

"If completed, the acquisition could offer Inland and (Altos) attractive attractive opportunities to expand their manufacturing capabilities globally, better supporting global customer needs and further expanding its product mix," Inland said.
"However, there is no assurance that Inland will participate in a bid or that its joint bid would be successful if submitted," said Inland, the sixth-largest U.S. steelmaker.
